name: MonarchSpaceSwitcher
title: SpaceSwitcher
wrapsNative: Button with MonarchButtonStyle (.ghost) presenting .sheet with NavigationStack, List, .searchable(text:prompt:), Link and presentationDetents([.medium, .large])
summary: Chooses which Space of the workspace the app shows, "All spaces" or one Space, from a button that opens a sheet with a searchable list, New Space and Manage Spaces.
whenToUse: In an app that scopes its content by Space: in the navigation bar, a sidebar header or a screen header, wherever the current Space is chosen.
whenNotToUse: To switch workspace use MonarchWorkspaceSwitcher. To filter one list by team or department use a filter in the list's own toolbar, such as a menu Picker.
api: init(selection: Binding<String?>, spaces: [MonarchSpaceOption], size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, allowsAll: Bool = true, isLoading: Bool = false, isIconOnly: Bool = false, hidesWhenEmpty: Bool = true, manageURL: URL? = nil, labels: MonarchSpaceSwitcherLabels = MonarchSpaceSwitcherLabels(), onCreate: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
struct MonarchSpaceOption { init(id: String, name: String, description: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchSpaceSwitcherLabels { init(label:, all:, placeholder:, search:, empty:, loading:, create:, manage:, cancel:) }

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen Space id, nil for All spaces.

options.name: spaces
options.description: The Spaces this person can open, in display order.

options.name: size
options.description: The height and padding of the button.

options.name: allowsAll
options.description: Offers All spaces first. Without it a Space must stay chosen and the button reads Choose a Space until one is.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: The Spaces are still loading; the list shows a progress indicator with Loading spaces.

options.name: isIconOnly
options.description: Shows only the Space's symbol and the chevron, for a narrow bar. The name stays the spoken value.

options.name: hidesWhenEmpty
options.description: Shows nothing when there are no Spaces and nothing is loading.

options.name: manageURL
options.description: Adds Manage Spaces, a Link that opens this URL.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Adds New Space, which closes the sheet and runs this.

states.name: all spaces
states.description: Nothing chosen: the button shows the layers symbol and All spaces; All spaces is checked in the list.

states.name: one space
states.description: The button shows the Space's symbol and name; its row is checked and has the selected trait.

states.name: no choice
states.description: With allowsAll false and nothing chosen the button reads Choose a Space.

states.name: searching
states.description: The list keeps the Spaces whose name or description contains the text; All spaces is hidden; with no match it reads No spaces match.

states.name: loading
states.description: The list ends with a progress indicator and Loading spaces.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no Spaces and nothing loading nothing is shown, unless hidesWhenEmpty is false.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Through disabled(_:), the ghost button style's disabled colours; the sheet cannot open.

appearance: A ghost MonarchButtonStyle button: the Space's symbol, the name in the default text colour and an up-down chevron in the muted text colour. The sheet is a system inset List; rows have a muted symbol, the name, a caption description in the muted text colour and an accent check mark; the actions are accent-tinted. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The parity map lists combobox as a dependency; MonarchCombobox is a labelled form field, so the switcher uses its own button and the same system sheet, List and search field that the combobox uses. The web opens a popover with a listbox (arrow keys, Home and End, type to search) from EntityPicker; on iPhone the same choice is a sheet with a system List and the system search field, as the plan names, and keyboard navigation is the system's. The web's tooltip on the collapsed trigger is the spoken value here, since a phone has no hover. Manage Spaces opens the URL with the environment's openURL, which leaves the app, so the web's "opens in a new tab" text and manageExternal have no counterpart; createHref is onCreate. The web's controlled open state and align are not offered. A Space id that is no longer in the list reads as All spaces, as on the web. Android builds the same component.
accessibility: The button is one element named "Space" whose value is the current Space or All spaces, also when only the icon shows.
Each row is a button named by the Space and its description ("Engineering, 18 members"), built by a tested pure function.
The chosen row has the selected trait and a check mark, so the choice does not depend on colour.
Rows, New Space and Manage Spaces keep a 44-point touch target.
Search is the system search field; Cancel closes the sheet without a change.
edgeCases: A selected id that is not in spaces reads as All spaces (or Choose a Space when All spaces is not offered).
Choosing All spaces when allowsAll is false does nothing.
Long Space names stay on one line on the button and wrap in the list.
The switcher never stores the choice; the app keeps selection.

@State private var space: String?
private let spaces = [
    MonarchSpaceOption(id: {{spaces.0.id}}, name: {{spaces.0.name}}, description: {{spaces.0.description}}),
    MonarchSpaceOption(id: {{spaces.1.id}}, name: {{spaces.1.name}}, description: {{spaces.1.description}}),
    MonarchSpaceOption(id: {{spaces.2.id}}, name: {{spaces.2.name}}, description: {{spaces.2.description}}),
    MonarchSpaceOption(id: {{spaces.3.id}}, name: {{spaces.3.name}}, description: {{spaces.3.description}}),
]

examples.title: A Space must stay chosen, icon only
examples.code:
MonarchSpaceSwitcher(
    selection: $space,
    spaces: [
        MonarchSpaceOption(id: "eng", name: "Engineering"),
        MonarchSpaceOption(id: "mkt", name: "Marketing", systemImage: "megaphone"),
    ],
    allowsAll: false,
    isIconOnly: true
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web opens the list as a popover under the trigger, so the trigger and the list show together. On iPhone the same choice is a medium or large sheet over the screen, with the system search field and Cancel; the trigger sits behind the sheet. The spaces, descriptions, check mark, search prompt, New Space and Manage Spaces match the web.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG: a popover from a control becomes a sheet on iPhone
